page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable, text-only review rules. Link them to agents — enabled skills are appended to the agent's prompt in order.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a markdown file or a skill archive.

page.selectHint: Select a skill to see its configuration, stats and versions.

card.importedTitle: Imported from a third party — wrapped as untrusted in the prompt
card.toggleLabel: Enable skill for all linked agents
card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {not linked} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a skill archive (.zip with SKILL.md). Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.trustTitle: You are adding someone else's instructions to your agents
import.trustBody: An imported skill goes into the agent's prompt as untrusted text. Read the body below before saving. Scripts and binaries from archives are never run — they are listed as ignored.
import.saved: Imported "{name}" — link it to an agent in the agent's Skills tab.

detail.runEvalsSoon: Evals arrive with the Eval lesson
detail.unsavedConfirm: Discard unsaved changes to this skill?

config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: A skill is plain text appended to an agent's prompt. It cannot run code or use tools.
config.enabledTitle: Disabled skills are not added to any agent's prompt
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: kebab-case identifier, shown in the prompt and the agent's Skills tab.
config.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive: when to apply it and what it flags. E.g. "Use on every PR that touches routes. Flag removed or renamed response fields."
config.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what to check and at which severity…
config.noteHint: Optional — shown in Versions. Saving a changed name, description, type or body creates a new version.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be unlinked from every agent.
config.toggleError: Could not change the enabled state

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported. Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt: it is wrapped as untrusted data and may only add review criteria — it cannot change the agent's role, output or severity rules.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

evals.title: Evals are coming
evals.body: Eval cases score a skill against known PRs (recall, precision, citation accuracy). They arrive with the Eval lesson — until then, compare runs with the skill on and off in the agent's Skills tab.

stats.pullHint: Share of runs (of agents using it) whose prompt included this skill
stats.acceptHint: Accepted ÷ (accepted + dismissed) findings from runs with this skill
stats.noAgents: Not linked to any agent yet — link it in an agent's Skills tab.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs with this skill in the last {days} days.
stats.window: Last {days} days · {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} with this skill. Runs before run attribution shipped are not counted.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its body becomes a new current version — history is kept.
